stories.title: Adrian Hamilton-Manns appointed new PIA chief executive officer
stories.brief: The board of Pakistan International Airlines (PIA) on Monday announced the appointment of Adrian Hamilton-Manns as its chief executive officer (CEO). In a press release, PIA said Hamilton-Manns “brings a wealth of leadership and strategic experience within the global aviation sector”, adding that his appointment “marks a pivotal chapter” in the airline’s ongoing transformation.

stories.title: Adrian Hamilton-Manns formally takes charge as PIA's new CEO
stories.brief: Adrian Hamilton-Manns has formally assumed charge as the new chief executive officer (CEO) of Pakistan International Airlines (PIA), bringing three decades of commercial aviation experience to the national flag carrier.

stories.title: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after largest-ever crypto hack
stories.brief: The exchange froze transactions following the incident which has been linked to a North Korean group.

stories.title: LHC directs jail authorities to arrange meeting between Noreen Niazi, her daughters
stories.brief: LAHORE: The Lahore High Court (LHC) on Monday directed jail authorities to arrange a meeting between Noreen Niazi, the sister of PTI founder Imran Khan, and her two daughters on Tuesday (tomorrow).

stories.title: Islamabad court sentences man to 7-year jail term for filming objectionable video of teenage boy
stories.brief: An Islamabad Additional District and Sessions Court sentenced Raja Haris Naveed to seven years of rigorous imprisonment in a cybercrime case involving the harassment of a 16-year-old boy and the recording of an objectionable video without his consent, it emerged on Monday.

stories.title: Oil refineries to bear Rs15b burden to ease fuel price pressure leading to Rs15 cut in petrol price
stories.brief: The government on Monday announced that oil refineries would bear a burden of Rs15 billion per month, which would allow petrol to be sold Rs15 cheaper than it was in the global market amid the US-Israeli war on Iran.

stories.title: Lahore's air quality index crosses 530 as pollution reaches hazardous levels
stories.brief: Several other cities in Punjab also recorded extremely high pollution levels, according to air quality monitoring platform IQAir. Figure shows the top ranked polluted cities in Pakistan according to IQAir on Friday morning. — Screengrab via IQAir The worsening air quality comes amid a sharp increase in agricultural fire detections across Punjab.

stories.title: Lahore's AQI soars to 535 early morning as air pollution reaches hazardous levels
stories.brief: The figures raised questions about the geographical limitations of Punjab's anti-smog strategy and whether Lahore could achieve cleaner air while pollution-producing activities continued across surrounding agricultural and industrial districts.

stories.title: LHC orders meeting between Noreen and her daughters, summons DC over detention extension
stories.brief: Justice Abher Gul Khan issued the directions while hearing petitions filed by Sakina Niazi and Shahraiz challenging the extension orders in detention of three sisters of Imran Khan and further seeking permission for the detained sisters to meet their family members.

stories.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
stories.brief: The temperature of freezers in several shops across Europe reportedly rose to as high as 50C.

stories.title: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
stories.brief: The airline says fuel prices may rise by €2bn in 2028 unless there is an end to the US-Israel war with Iran.

stories.title: 'Rok' solid recognition for Slovenian space scientist
stories.brief: Two men from the Armagh Planetarium and Observatory have had asteroids named in their honour in recognition of their work.
